statements.text: Cobalt Sulfate for Electroplating High-purity cobalt sulfate crystals for decorative and engineering electroplating baths. HTS 2833.29.10.00 applies as pure cobalt sulfate salt used in metal finishing.

Anhydrous Cobalt Sulfate Anhydrous cobalt(II) sulfate (CoSO4) is a white crystalline powder used in catalyst production and analytical chemistry. It qualifies for HTS 2833.29.10.00 as the water-free sulfate of cobalt.
Feed Grade Cobalt Sulfate Cobalt sulfate granular form (24% Co minimum) for trace mineral supplementation in livestock feed. Remains under HTS 2833.29.10.00 as chemically defined cobalt sulfate.

Cobalt(II) sulfate heptahydrate (CoSO4·7H2O) is a pink crystalline salt used in electroplating baths and as a cobalt source in fertilizers. It falls under HTS 2833.29.10.00 as a sulfate of cobalt, classified among other sulfates of metals per Chapter 28 notes.

Technical Grade Cobalt Sulfate Technical grade cobalt sulfate (approx. 20-24% Co) for industrial pigment and battery applications. Classified in HTS 2833.29.10.00 as other sulfates of cobalt, provided chemically defined.
